auditoria-seo.meta_description: Complete SEO analysis and audit to identify errors, opportunities, and create a clear roadmap to improve your organic ranking.
auditoria-seo.titulo_principal: Uncover Your Website's Hidden Potential with an SEO Audit
auditoria-seo.subtitulo: The foundation of any successful organic growth strategy. Identify the errors holding back your visibility and the opportunities that will make you take off.

seccion_que_es.titulo: What is an SEO Audit and What is it for?
seccion_que_es.texto_html:
An SEO audit is a complete and in-depth diagnosis of your website's health regarding search engines. It's not just a list of errors, but a strategic analysis that allows us to understand why your site isn't reaching its full potential and what specific actions we must take to fix it.

It is the essential first step before investing in any other marketing action, ensuring that your efforts are built on a solid and optimized foundation.

seccion_que_analizamos.titulo: What Do We Analyze in the SEO Audit?

pilares.descripcion: We ensure Google can crawl and index your website without issues.
puntos: Analysis of robots.txt and sitemap.xml files

pilares.descripcion: We optimize your content to match user search intent.
puntos: Optimization of Titles and Meta Descriptions

pilares.descripcion: We assess your domain's authority and link profile.
puntos: Detection of toxic or low-quality links

seccion_que_recibiras.titulo: What Will You Receive upon Completion?

entregables.descripcion: A PDF document without unnecessary jargon, explaining each finding, its importance, and how to fix it.
A spreadsheet (Google Sheets) with all the tasks to be done, ordered by priority (impact vs. effort), so you know where to start.
A 60-minute video call to present the results, answer all your questions, and define the next steps.

preguntas.pregunta: How long does an SEO audit take?
preguntas.respuesta: It depends on the size and complexity of the website, but generally, the entire process, from analysis to delivery of the report, usually takes between 1 and 2 weeks.
The audit service includes the diagnosis and the action plan. The implementation of the changes can be quoted separately as a project or through a retainer of hours, according to your needs.

seccion_que_es.titulo: What is an AI SEO Audit?
seccion_que_es.texto_html: SEO is evolving. My LLM audit service analyzes how your content answers conversational queries and how it can stand out in new generative search experiences (SGE). It's not just about keywords, but about topical authority and entities.

puntos: Use of structured data for entities
Optimization for 'People Also Ask' and 'Featured Snippets'

entregables.descripcion: A document defining your 'Entity SEO' and topical authority strategy.
A guide with topics and content formats optimized for conversational search.

consultor-google-ads.meta_description: Professional Google Ads management service to maximize your ROI. Creation, optimization, and tracking of campaigns.
consultor-google-ads.subtitulo: Invest smartly and get qualified leads from day one.

seccion_que_es.texto_html: Managing Google Ads campaigns goes beyond choosing keywords. It requires constant optimization of bids, audiences, creatives, and landing pages to avoid wasting your budget. I handle this complex task so you can focus on your business.

pilares.descripcion: We define objectives and set up everything for accurate tracking.
We monitor and adjust campaigns to improve performance.
puntos: A/B testing of ads and landing pages
Search term analysis and negative keywords

entregables.descripcion: A clear report with key metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS) and insights from the month.
You will have full access to the Google Ads account for complete transparency.

preguntas.pregunta: What is the recommended minimum investment?
preguntas.respuesta: It heavily depends on the industry, but I recommend starting with a daily budget that allows for enough data collection to optimize, usually starting from €15-€20/day.

analitica-digital.meta_description: Expert implementation and setup of GTM, GA4, Search Console, BigQuery, and Google Business Profile.
analitica-digital.subtitulo: Make decisions based on reliable and well-structured data.

seccion_que_es.titulo: Why is a Good Setup Crucial?
seccion_que_es.texto_html: Without accurate data collection, any marketing effort is like navigating blind. A robust technical setup ensures you are measuring what truly matters and that you can trust your metrics to make strategic decisions.

pilares.descripcion: I centralize the management of all your tracking tags.
I configure your property to measure the customer lifecycle.
I integrate and optimize your entire data ecosystem.

entregables.descripcion: A file detailing all the configurations made and how they work.
A basic dashboard in Looker Studio with the most important metrics to start monitoring.

preguntas.pregunta: Can you fix an existing GA4 setup?
preguntas.respuesta: Yes, a large part of my work consists of auditing and correcting GA4 and GTM implementations to ensure data reliability.

linkbuilding.meta_description: Quality link building strategies to increase your domain authority and improve your Google rankings.
linkbuilding.subtitulo: Build the authority your domain needs to compete.

seccion_que_es.texto_html: Link building is not about getting hundreds of low-quality links, but about earning editorial mentions on relevant and authoritative websites. My approach is 100% 'white-hat', focused on building relationships and providing value to get links that boost your SEO sustainably.

pilares.descripcion: We study your current link profile and that of your competitors.
We identify and contact relevant websites.
puntos: Search for quality blogs, media, and directories
Creation of value propositions for contact

entregables.descripcion: A monthly report with the links obtained, their metrics (DR, traffic), and the anchor text used.
Monitoring how the link building strategy impacts your rankings for target keywords.

preguntas.pregunta: Do you guarantee a certain number of links per month?
preguntas.respuesta: No. Quality link building does not work with numerical guarantees. My goal is quality and relevance, not quantity. I will keep you informed of the progress and contacts made at all times.

aumento-visibilidad-katarsia.titulo: 1st place on Google for a clinic in Barcelona: IV Therapy Treatment
aumento-visibilidad-katarsia.problema: To improve the sales of this high-margin treatment.
aumento-visibilidad-katarsia.solucion: Informative content was developed about the different compounds of IV Therapy, and a market analysis was conducted in the United States to adapt it to the Spanish market.
aumento-visibilidad-katarsia.resultado: We achieved a 564% increase in organic traffic in 3 months and a 45% increase in sales directly attributed to organic search in one month.

seo-local-macan.titulo: Organic Positioning Improvement for Law Firm
seo-local-macan.problema: The law firm needed to improve its visibility on Google to attract new clients.
seo-local-macan.solucion: After conducting a technical audit, the tags were improved, keywords used by competitors were included, and the website structure was enhanced.
seo-local-macan.resultado: As a result of the work done, organic visibility increased by 466%, and the position in the SERP results improved, which increased the number of clicks by 249%.
